items.summary: Christian Herdtweck discovered that Fetchmail incorrectly handled certain long log messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Fetchmail to crash, resulting in a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. items.title: USN-9012-1: libheif vulnerability
items.summary: Alex Thomas discovered that libheif incorrectly handled certain HEIF images. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code if a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted file.

items.title: USN-9008-1: libnfs vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that libnfs did not properly enforce the maximum size bound during ZDR decoding, resulting in an out-of-bounds write. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause libnfs to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code.
